scope: Theorem 1.3 (A common positive representation) of the manuscript “The complete Crouzeix theorem: optimal similarity and a common positive boundary representation” (preprints/The-complete-Crouzeix-theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 325 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5e37fffcae2be84), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With the same Ω, A, f, G and any chosen minimizing metric in Theorem 1.2, there is one continuous function Λ : T → Mn(C) satisfying Λ(t) ⪰ 0, Z T Λ(t) dσ(t) = In, such that, for every positive integer m and every Mm(C)-valued function v holomorphic on a neighborhood of Ω, v[A′ ] = Z T Λ(t) ⊗ v(G(t)) dσ(t), ∥v[A]∥ ≤ κ max Ω ∥v∥. (1.2) The same S, Λ, and κ work for all m and v.
